question: What is our National Anthem? 🇮🇳
explanation: Awesome! 'Jana Gana Mana' is our beautiful National Anthem that we sing with pride! 🇮🇳
hint: We sing this special song in our school assembly.

question: What must we do when we hear our National Anthem? 🎵
explanation: Super! We must always stand straight and still to show respect to our country! 🇮🇳
hint: We do this in assembly to show respect.

question: Who wrote our National Anthem? ✍️
explanation: Great job! Rabindranath Tagore wrote our National Anthem in a very sweet melody. 🎼
hint: He was a very famous poet who won a big prize.

question: Where do we sing the National Anthem every morning? 🏫
explanation: Awesome! We sing it together with all our friends in the school assembly! 🏫
hint: It is the place where all students gather in the morning.

question: How should we stand during the National Anthem? 🧍
explanation: Super! Standing straight and tall shows that we are proud of our country! 🇮🇳
hint: Like a brave soldier!

question: Where should we keep our hands while singing the anthem? 👐
explanation: Great job! We keep our hands strictly by our sides to stand in the attention position. 🧍
hint: This is called the 'attention' posture.

question: What do we look at while singing the National Anthem? 👀
explanation: Awesome! We look at our beautiful Tricolour flag with a lot of respect and love. 🇮🇳
hint: It has three beautiful colors.

question: How should we sing the National Anthem? 🎤
explanation: Super! We must sing the words clearly and proudly so everyone can hear our love for India! 🎶
hint: We sing it with a strong and happy voice.

question: How much time does it take to sing the full National Anthem? ⏱️
explanation: Great job! It takes exactly 52 seconds to sing the full National Anthem correctly. ⏱️
hint: It is just a little less than one minute.

question: How do we feel when we sing our National Anthem? ❤️
explanation: Awesome! Singing for our country fills our hearts with pride, joy, and love! ❤️
hint: It is a very good and strong feeling.

question: On which special day do we hoist the flag and sing the anthem? 🎈
explanation: Super! We celebrate our country's freedom on Independence Day by hoisting the flag! 🎉
hint: We celebrate this on the 15th of August.

question: What is the top color of our National Flag? 🎨
explanation: Great job! The beautiful orange-like color at the top is called Saffron. 🟠
hint: It looks like the color of an orange.

question: What is the middle color of our National Flag? 🤍
explanation: Awesome! The middle band is pure white, and it has a blue wheel on it! ⚪
hint: It is the color of milk and peace.

question: What is the bottom color of our National Flag? 🌿
explanation: Super! The rich green color at the bottom shows our green plants and trees. 🌳
hint: It is the color of fresh leaves.

question: What is drawn in the center of our National Flag? ☸️
explanation: Great job! The Ashoka Chakra is a wheel with 24 spokes in the middle of our flag. ☸️
hint: It looks like a round wheel.

question: What is the color of the Ashoka Chakra? 🔵
explanation: Awesome! The wheel in the center is a bright and beautiful Navy Blue! 🔵
hint: It is the color of the deep ocean.

question: What is another name for our National Flag? 🇮🇳
explanation: Super! 'Tiranga' means Tricolor, because our flag has three main colors! 🇮🇳
hint: It means 'three colors' in Hindi.

question: What do we show to our country when we sing the anthem? 🤝
explanation: Great job! We sing it to show how much we respect and love our motherland. 🌍
hint: A very sweet feeling in our hearts.

question: What should we do if we are walking and hear the National Anthem playing? 🚶
explanation: Awesome! We must always stop whatever we are doing and stand still to show respect. 🧍
hint: We need to pause our walking.

question: Who sings the National Anthem? 🎤
explanation: Super! Every single person in India sings the National Anthem together! 🇮🇳
hint: All citizens of the country.

question: What is the very first word of our National Anthem? 📖
explanation: Great job! The song starts with the beautiful word 'Jana'. 🎶
hint: It is the first word in the title.

question: What are the finishing words of our National Anthem? 🔚
explanation: Awesome! We end the anthem by singing 'Jaya He, Jaya He, Jaya He'! 🎉
hint: It means 'Victory to thee'.

question: Which musical instrument can play the National Anthem beautifully? 🪈
explanation: Super! The flute (Basuri) makes a very sweet and peaceful sound for our anthem. 🎼
hint: You blow air into this to make music.

question: How do we sing the anthem in school? 🏫
explanation: Great job! We sing it as a big group or choir so our voices blend together nicely. 🎶
hint: When many people sing together.

question: What important lesson does the National Anthem teach us? 🤝
explanation: Awesome! It teaches us that all Indians are one big, loving family! ❤️
hint: Staying together as friends.

question: What do we love to draw in our art book on Republic Day? 🖍️
explanation: Super! Drawing the Tiranga on special days shows our patriotic spirit in art! 🎨
hint: Our country's beautiful symbol.

question: What does the Saffron color in our flag stand for? 🦁
explanation: Great job! Saffron reminds us to be brave and strong for our country. 💪
hint: Being brave like a lion.

question: What does the White color in our flag stand for? 🕊️
explanation: Awesome! White teaches us to be peaceful, kind, and to always speak the truth. 🤍
hint: Being calm and quiet like a dove.

question: What does the Green color in our flag stand for? 🌱
explanation: Super! Green stands for our rich soil, trees, and growing crops! 🌾
hint: It is the color of nature.

question: Which beautiful bird is our National Bird? 🦚
explanation: Great job! The Peacock is our National Bird and has lovely, colorful feathers! 🦚
hint: It dances when it rains.

question: Which strong animal is our National Animal? 🐅
explanation: Awesome! The strong and beautiful Royal Bengal Tiger is our National Animal! 🐅
hint: It has orange fur with black stripes.

question: Which lovely flower is our National Flower? 🪷
explanation: Super! The beautiful pink Lotus that grows in water is our National Flower! 🌸
hint: It grows in ponds and lakes.

question: Which yummy fruit is our National Fruit? 🥭
explanation: Great job! The sweet and juicy Mango is the king of fruits and our National Fruit! 🥭
hint: We eat this yellow fruit in summer.

question: Which huge tree is our National Tree? 🌳
explanation: Awesome! The huge Banyan tree gives a lot of shade and is our National Tree! 🌳
hint: It has roots that hang from its branches.

question: How many main colors are there in our Tiranga? 🎨
explanation: Super! Tiranga means 'three colors': Saffron, White, and Green! 🎨
hint: The number comes after two.

question: What is the shape of our National Flag? 📏
explanation: Great job! The flag has four sides and looks like a beautiful rectangle! 📏
hint: It looks like the shape of your classroom board.

question: What special song brings all Indians together? 🎼
explanation: Awesome! The National Anthem makes us feel like one big happy family! ❤️
hint: We stand up for this song.

question: If the National Anthem plays on the television, what is the best thing to do? 📺
explanation: Super! Even at home, we should stand up to show respect when the anthem plays. 🇮🇳
hint: We show respect just like in school.

question: Sometimes, the anthem plays before a movie starts. What should we do? 🍿
explanation: Great job! We must always stand up straight in the cinema hall to respect our anthem! 🎬
hint: We leave our seats for a minute.

question: What is the name of our wonderful country? 🗺️
explanation: Awesome! We live in a beautiful country called India, also known as Bharat! 🌍
hint: Look at the map we study in class.

question: What is our National Song? 🎶
explanation: Super! 'Vande Mataram' is our National Song, and we love singing it too! 🎤
hint: It starts with the letter V.

question: How does the National Anthem sound to our ears? 🎧
explanation: Great job! The melody is very sweet and fills us with brave feelings! ❤️
hint: It makes us feel happy and strong.

question: Who loves our country the most? 🤗
explanation: Awesome! We all love our country India very, very much! 🇮🇳
hint: Every citizen loves it.

question: Who protects our beautiful country? 🛡️
explanation: Super! Our brave soldiers work day and night to keep our country safe! 🫡
hint: They wear uniforms and guard the borders.

question: How should we hold the National Flag in our hands? 🚩
explanation: Great job! We must always hold the flag high up to show our great respect! 🇮🇳
hint: Towards the sky.

question: Which festival do we celebrate on the 15th of August? 🎉
explanation: Awesome! We celebrate our freedom and hoist the flag on Independence Day! 🎈
hint: The day we became a free country.

question: Which festival do we celebrate on the 26th of January? 🎖️
explanation: Super! We watch the big parade in New Delhi on Republic Day! 🪖
hint: We have a big parade on this day.

question: What do we feel for our National Flag? 🥰
explanation: Great job! Seeing our flag fly high fills our hearts with great pride! ❤️
hint: A very happy and respectful feeling.

question: Who wrote our National Song, Vande Mataram? ✍️
explanation: Awesome! Bankim Chandra Chatterjee wrote our beautiful National Song! 🎶
hint: His first name is Bankim.

question: What makes India so beautiful? 🌸
explanation: Super! India is beautiful because all of us live together with love and peace! 🇮🇳
hint: You, me, and everyone around us!
